nodes.title: Open-world terrain tiles (read me first)
widgets_values:
A 4 km × 4 km island for an open world, delivered as 4 × 4 tiles, engine-agnostic:
  · Height: 1025² samples, 4 m per cell; each tile a 257² 16-bit PNG, **neighbouring tiles share the row of pixels on their common edge** (heights at the seams are bit-identical when stitched); metres = minimum + value × range, the range is in Height.json's range_scaled (one range for the whole map, the same for all tiles; the sea floor is negative). A full-map .r16 is included too.
  · Weight maps: seven layers Grass / ForestFloor / Sediment / Rock / Sand / Water / Road, one 8-bit greyscale PNG per tile per layer, **summing to 1 everywhere** (usable directly as the engine's terrain layers).
  · Instances: trees (3 pine and 2 broadleaf kinds, split by altitude), bushes, rocks (asset names match the SM_Rock_0N exported by the rock pipeline), written as CSV in 1024 m tiles, plus Instances_index.json listing each tile.
  · Roads: centre lines as OBJ polylines (on the cut road bed), and 1 m terrain textures (BaseColor + normal) in 1024² tiles.

Coordinate convention (written into every .json): origin at the north-west corner = top left of the height map, x east, z south (matching image row order), y up, units in metres. Instance transforms are read the same way as Copy to Points, so what the preview places is what the table says.

① Terrain, grown by its rivers: an island outline, a ridged uplift map (the main range) and a rock-hardness map → Stream Power at 513² with the sea as base level: the whole island rises while rivers cut it, hard rock stands as crags → resize to 1025² → buttresses and couloirs down the steep faces, gully pattern (erosion filter) → HeightField Erode → distort → erode again (Houdini's recipe; writes the flow, sediment and debris masks) → flow accumulation → river beds cut 1.5-5 m into the valley floors → town sites on flat low ground, a road network between them at a 10% grade (switchbacks on the hills), cut into the ground. About three minutes on numpy, much less with CUDA.
② Ecology and colour from the erosion masks: cliffs above 55°, scree below them, sand on the beach and in the river beds, water in the sea and the trunk rivers, woodland in the valleys, grass that is lush where water collects, dry on the ridges and heath-coloured on the high ground, darker along every gully.
③ Distribution: each of the three instance kinds scatters by its density map, samples height, picks an asset and sets orientation (trees upright with random rotation, rocks tilted a bit towards the slope).
④ Write files + preview: the full-map mesh with instance proxies and a sea to the horizon, shot from the air in the Outdoor look (afternoon sun, clouds, haze).

# island outline: distance from the centre, pushed in and out by two scales of noise (bays, headlands)
dx = @u - 0.5
dy = @v - 0.5
r = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 2
coast = 0.78 + 0.45 * (noise(set(@u * 2.3, @v * 2.3, 1.7)) - 0.5) + 0.16 * (noise(set(@u * 7, @v * 7, 5.2)) - 0.5)
land = smoothstep(0.0, 0.10, coast - r)
# the sea is the rivers' base level (Stream Power's Outlet Layer)
@sea = 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.004, coast - r)
# uplift: a ridged spine (the main range) with spurs, massifs on it, low toward the coast
w1 = 0.6 * (noise(set(@u * 2.0, @v * 2.0, 7.7)) - 0.5)
rn = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(@u * 2.2 + w1, @v * 2.2 - w1, 3.1)) - 1)
rn2 = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(@u * 5.5 + w1, @v * 5.5, 8.8)) - 1)
pk = noise(set(@u * 3.1, @v * 3.1, 9.4))
@up = land * (0.15 + 0.9 * rn ** 3 + 0.25 * rn2 ** 2 + 0.6 * smoothstep(0.45, 0.8, pk)) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.5, coast - r + 0.15)
# rock (Stream Power's Erodibility Layer): hard cores and dykes stand as crags and cliffs (K x 0.6), soft basins
# wear into broad low valleys (K x 1.5)
hard = smoothstep(0.58, 0.68, noise(set(@u * 5, @v * 5, 2.2)))
dyke = smoothstep(0.93, 0.97, 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(@u * 4 + 0.5 * w1, @v * 9, 6.6)) - 1))
soft = smoothstep(0.55, 0.68, noise(set(@u * 3.3, @v * 3.3, 4.4)))
@kk = lerp(lerp(1.0, 1.5, soft), 0.6, max(hard, dyke))
@land = land
@C = lerp(-0.012, 0.004 + 0.01 * @C, land)

# buttresses and couloirs down the steep faces: sharp ridged noise across the slope (120 m and 45 m apart),
# stretched down it, up to ~25 m deep -- a steady-state slope is otherwise one smooth plane
x = @u * 4100
y = @v * 4100
hm = @C * 2048
gl = sqrt(@Nd.x * @Nd.x + @Nd.y * @Nd.y) + 1e-4
s = (x * (0 - @Nd.y) + y * @Nd.x) / gl
rib = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(s / 120, hm / 260, 3.7)) - 1)
rib2 = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(s / 45, hm / 110, 8.1)) - 1)
face = smoothstep(0.12, 0.35, 1 - @Nd.z) * @land
@C = @C + (25 * (rib * rib - 0.4) + 10 * (rib2 * rib2 - 0.4)) / 2048 * face
# hollows (60-150 m), rock roughness (10-50 m), on the land only; and a copy of the height for the mask blend
n1 = noise(set(@u * 34, @v * 34, 1.1)) - 0.5
n2 = noise(set(@u * 90, @v * 90, 2.3)) - 0.5
n3 = noise(set(@u * 220, @v * 220, 4.7)) - 0.5
@C = @C + (0.006 * n1 + 0.0025 * n2 + 0.001 * n3) * @land
# the same rock for the water as for the rivers: HeightField Erode's hardness (0-1) from Stream Power's K
@hard = clamp((1.5 - @kk) * 0.65, 0, 0.6)
@pre = @C

widgets_values:
hm = @C * 2048
tn = normalize(set(@N.x, @N.z, -@N.y))
@tn = tn
steep = 1 - @N.z
wet = clamp(@flow, 0, 1) * @land
hn = clamp(hm / (@C.max() * 2048), 0, 1)
@hn = hn
# water: the sea (below 0 m), and the trunk rivers (largest catchments) inside their beds
sea = 1 - smoothstep(-0.6, 0.3, hm)
big = smoothstep(0.003, 0.05, @catchment)
riv = @bed * smoothstep(0.25, 0.7, big)
water = clamp(max(sea, riv), 0, 1)
# cliffs: above ~55 degrees everywhere; from ~45 degrees on in patches (bare outcrops in the grass)
cliff = max(smoothstep(0.38, 0.48, steep), smoothstep(0.27, 0.35, steep) * smoothstep(0.5, 0.65, noise(set(@u * 40, @v * 40, 2.2)) + 0.2 * (noise(set(@u * 140, @v * 140, 5.5)) - 0.5)))
# sand: the beach (0-4 m above the sea, gentle), dry river beds and gravel bars
beach = (1 - smoothstep(2.5, 6.0, hm + 2.0 * (noise(set(@u * 25, @v * 25, 7.1)) - 0.5))) * (1 - smoothstep(0.08, 0.2, steep))
sand = clamp(max(beach, @bed * (1 - smoothstep(0.25, 0.7, big))), 0, 1)
# scree: what slumped (debris), below the cliffs
scree = smoothstep(0.0006, 0.003, @debris) * (1 - cliff)
# woodland: valleys and lower slopes where water collects, in clumps; not on cliffs, sand or scree
soil = (1 - cliff) * (1 - sand) * (1 - scree) * (1 - smoothstep(0.30, 0.42, steep))
clump = smoothstep(0.5, 0.62, 0.55 * noise(set(@u * 6, @v * 6, 1.7)) + 0.25 * noise(set(@u * 26, @v * 26, 4.2)) + 0.45 * wet - 0.35 * hn + 0.06)
wood = clamp(soil * clump, 0, 1)
# layer the seven weights: each takes its share of what the ones above left; the road first (fords and
# bridges cross the rivers), then water
road = clamp(@road, 0, 1)
@Road = road
rem = 1 - road
@Water = rem * water
rem = rem * (1 - water)
@Sand = rem * sand
rem = rem * (1 - sand)
@Rock = rem * cliff
rem = rem * (1 - cliff)
@Sediment = rem * scree
rem = rem * (1 - scree)
@ForestFloor = rem * wood
@Grass = rem * (1 - wood)
# the verges are kept clear (the cut and fill corridor)
clear = (1 - smoothstep(0.05, 0.4, @rdw)) * (1 - 0.85 * @town)
# houses: in the towns, along the roads (not on them), on flat dry land
@d_house = @town * smoothstep(0.08, 0.5, @rdn) * (1 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.25, @rdw)) * (1 - smoothstep(0.03, 0.08, steep)) * (1 - water) * (1 - smoothstep(0.05, 0.3, @bed))
@d_tree = (@ForestFloor + 0.03 * @Grass * (1 - smoothstep(0.5, 0.7, hn))) * clear
edge_ = wood * (1 - wood) * 4
@d_bush = @Grass * (0.3 * edge_ + 0.3 * wet + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, hn)) * smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, noise(set(@u * 23, @v * 23, 5.3))) * clear
@d_rock = (0.5 * @Sediment + 0.25 * @Rock * (1 - 0.6 * @Rock) + 0.1 * @Sand * @bed) * clear
@wet = wet
# colour (display values, made linear at the end)
rv = noise(set(@u * 9, @v * 9, 2.6))
bedd = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(hm / 7 + 9 * noise(set(@u * 3, @v * 3, 6.1)))
rock = lerp(set(0.30, 0.29, 0.26), set(0.52, 0.51, 0.48), rv) * (0.82 + 0.26 * bedd)
rock = lerp(rock, rock * set(1.06, 0.98, 0.88), smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, noise(set(@u * 4, hm / 40, 3.3))))
rock = rock * (1 - 0.45 * smoothstep(0.3, 0.9, wet))
# a colour map out of the erosion masks (as in Project Pegasus): ridges and edges lighter, hollows darker
conv = smoothstep(-0.06, 0.06, @curv)
rock = rock * (0.78 + 0.4 * conv)
screec = set(0.58, 0.55, 0.50) * (0.88 + 0.24 * noise(set(@u * 80, @v * 80, 3.9)))
sandc = lerp(set(0.66, 0.60, 0.47), set(0.50, 0.46, 0.38), @bed) * (0.92 + 0.16 * noise(set(@u * 50, @v * 50, 8.1)))
sandc = lerp(sandc, sandc * 0.72, 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, hm))
# grass: lush in the valleys, dry yellow-green on sunny ridges, olive heath on the high ground
dry = clamp(0.6 * smoothstep(0.4, 0.8, noise(set(@u * 7, @v * 7, 4.4))) + 0.4 * steep * 4 - 0.9 * wet, 0, 1)
grass = lerp(set(0.17, 0.29, 0.09), set(0.36, 0.40, 0.17), dry)
grass = lerp(grass, set(0.33, 0.36, 0.20), smoothstep(0.55, 0.85, hn + 0.15 * (noise(set(@u * 12, @v * 12, 9.9)) - 0.5)))
grass = grass * (0.86 + 0.28 * noise(set(@u * 45, @v * 45, 7.7)))
# darker in the gullies (damp soil, shade-loving plants): the drainage pattern reads in the colour too
grass = grass * (1 - 0.28 * smoothstep(0.35, 0.9, wet))
# spurs dry and pale, hollows damp and dark; fresh sediment (the fans the water laid down) a pale silt-green
grass = lerp(grass * set(0.86, 0.92, 0.86), grass * set(1.12, 1.08, 0.9), conv)
grass = lerp(grass, set(0.46, 0.45, 0.30), 0.55 * smoothstep(0.003, 0.012, @sediment))
woodc = set(0.15, 0.21, 0.09) * (0.85 + 0.3 * noise(set(@u * 60, @v * 60, 1.3)))
deep = smoothstep(0.0, -14.0, hm)
waterc = lerp(set(0.16, 0.36, 0.38), set(0.03, 0.10, 0.17), deep)
waterc = lerp(waterc, set(0.10, 0.19, 0.21), riv)
roadc = set(0.60, 0.53, 0.41) * (0.9 + 0.2 * noise(set(@u * 300, @v * 300, 6.4)))
c = grass * @Grass + woodc * @ForestFloor + screec * @Sediment + rock * @Rock + sandc * @Sand + waterc * @Water + roadc * @Road
@albedo = (c * (0.95 + 0.1 * noise(set(@u * 150, @v * 150, 2.2)))) ** 2.2
# the grass and rock colours on their own, for the 1 m surface textures
@grass_c = grass
@rock_c = rock

widgets_values:
# the 1 m surface: crisp material edges, rock strata and joints, rills, mottled grass; a detail height for the normal map
x = @u * 4100
y = @v * 4100
hm = @Ce * 2048
# the erosion filter's rills and spurs (metres): what it cut or left above the 4 m surface
ero = (@Ce - @C) * 2048
n4 = noise(set(x / 4, y / 4, 1.3))
n15 = noise(set(x / 15, y / 15, 2.9))
n50 = noise(set(x / 50, y / 50, 4.1))
# joint cracks (cell edges of a Worley pattern), only in patches
crk = (1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.12, (@cr + 1) * 0.5)) * smoothstep(0.45, 0.6, n15)
gl = sqrt(@N.x * @N.x + @N.y * @N.y) + 1e-4
s = (x * (0 - @N.y) + y * @N.x) / gl
st = noise(set(s / 2.5, hm / 25, 5.5))
# crisp outcrops: the rock weight pushed past a ragged threshold; spurs (ero > 0) shed their soil first
land = 1 - @Water
rk = smoothstep(0.42, 0.58, @Rock + 0.55 * (n15 - 0.5) + 0.3 * (n4 - 0.5) + 0.06 * ero) * land
k = where(land - @Rock > 1e-4, (land - rk) / max(land - @Rock, 1e-4), 0 * rk)
sd = @Sand * k
sc = @Sediment * k
ff = @ForestFloor * k
gr = @Grass * k
# rock: beds of two thicknesses (5 m and 13 m, warped, terraced where the faces are hard), joint cracks, rough;
# colour banded by bed, lichen on the tops, dark streaks down the faces
sp = (hm + 18 * (n50 - 0.5) + 5 * (n15 - 0.5)) / 5
band = sp - floor(sp)
sp2 = (hm + 30 * (n50 - 0.5)) / 13 + 0.37
band2 = sp2 - floor(sp2)
hard = smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, noise(set(x / 140, y / 140, hm / 60)))
terr = (5 * (smoothstep(0.1, 0.9, band) - band) * (0.3 + 0.7 * hard) + 9 * (smoothstep(0.2, 0.8, band2) - band2) * (1 - 0.6 * hard)) * 0.6
# (the terraces stay in the colour only: in the relief they crossed the rills in zigzags on every face)
# couloirs and ribs down the faces: sharp ridged noise across the slope, stretched down it
rib = 1 - abs(2 * noise(set(s / 7, hm / 45, 7.3)) - 1)
dr = 0.15 * hard * terr - 0.5 * crk + 0.3 * (n4 - 0.5) + 0.8 * (n15 - 0.5) + 2.2 * rib * rib + 1.2 * (st - 0.5)
bedc = 0.92 + 0.16 * noise(set(floor(sp) * 1.7, x / 300, 6.6))
rock = @rock_c * bedc * (1 - 0.3 * crk) * (0.9 + 0.2 * n4)
varn = smoothstep(0.5, 0.75, st) * (1 - 0.5 * smoothstep(0.6, 0.9, band))
rock = lerp(rock, rock * set(0.55, 0.52, 0.5), 0.6 * varn)
rock = lerp(rock, rock * set(1.18, 1.0, 0.78), 0.6 * smoothstep(0.5, 0.7, n50) * (1 - varn))
# ledge tops catch the light and the debris: lighter; the faces under them darker
rock = rock * (0.85 + 0.3 * smoothstep(0.75, 0.95, band))
lich = smoothstep(0.62, 0.72, n4 + 0.4 * (n15 - 0.5)) * smoothstep(0.75, 0.9, @N.z + 0.15 * band)
rock = lerp(rock, set(0.62, 0.62, 0.52), 0.5 * lich)
# grass: mottled at 4 / 15 / 50 m, greener and darker in the rills, dry on the spurs, bare soil where the rill walls are steep
g = @grass_c * (0.72 + 0.4 * n15 + 0.2 * n4)
# patches of a cooler, darker green (fern, scrub) and of a warmer one, at 50 m
g = lerp(g, g * set(0.75, 0.92, 0.85), smoothstep(0.55, 0.7, n50))
g = lerp(g, g * set(1.1, 1.0, 0.8), smoothstep(0.55, 0.7, 1 - n50) * 0.6)
g = lerp(g, g * set(1.06, 1.04, 0.9), smoothstep(0.5, 2.0, ero) * 0.3)
g = lerp(g, g * set(0.82, 0.92, 0.8), smoothstep(-0.5, -2.0, ero) * 0.4)
soilc = set(0.42, 0.35, 0.26) * (0.85 + 0.3 * n4)
bare = smoothstep(0.62, 0.75, n15 + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.1, 0.3, 1 - @N.z) + 0.12 * ero) * (1 - @wet)
g = lerp(g, soilc, 0.85 * bare)
dg = 0.25 * (n4 - 0.5) + 0.15 * (n15 - 0.5)
# forest floor, scree (stones and gaps), sand (wet at the waterline), water
wood = set(0.14, 0.17, 0.08) * (0.75 + 0.5 * n4)
stn = (@cr + 1) * 0.5
scr = set(0.56, 0.53, 0.48) * (0.7 + 0.45 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.25, stn)) * (0.85 + 0.3 * n15)
dsc = 0.35 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.3, stn)
sand = lerp(set(0.68, 0.62, 0.49), set(0.40, 0.37, 0.31), @bed) * (0.92 + 0.12 * n4 + 0.08 * n15)
sand = lerp(sand, sand * 0.68, 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.5, hm))
deep = smoothstep(0.0, -14.0, hm)
wat = lerp(set(0.16, 0.36, 0.38), set(0.03, 0.10, 0.17), deep)
c = rock * rk + g * gr + wood * ff + scr * sc + sand * sd + wat * @Water
# the detail height (metres) for the normal map: rills strongest on soil, ledges and joints on rock
em = 0.2 + 0.4 * smoothstep(0.3, 0.7, n50)
dh = (em * ero * (1 - rk) * land + dr * rk + dg * gr + dsc * sc)
# rills a little darker than the spurs between them
c = c * (1 + 0.04 * clamp(ero, -2, 2) * land)
# the roads, drawn at 1 m (the Road weight at 4 m is only a blur here): the other layers fill the rest,
# a worn verge, then packed dirt with gravel; flat in the normal map
wsum = rk + gr + ff + sc + sd + @Water
c = c / max(wsum, 0.05)
verge = clamp(@rdv - @rd, 0, 1) * land
c = lerp(c, c * set(0.9, 0.86, 0.78) + set(0.05, 0.04, 0.03), 0.6 * verge)
roadc = set(0.60, 0.53, 0.41) * (0.82 + 0.22 * n4 + 0.12 * (crk - 0.3)) * (1 - 0.15 * @wet)
c = lerp(c, roadc, @rd * land)
ruts = @ruts * @rd * land
c = lerp(c, c * set(0.6, 0.56, 0.5), 0.9 * ruts)
crown = @crown * @rd * land * (1 - ruts)
c = lerp(c, set(0.36, 0.40, 0.20) * (0.8 + 0.3 * n4), 0.75 * crown)
dh = dh * (1 - @rdv * land) - 0.08 * ruts + 0.03 * crown
@terrain_albedo = clamp(c, 0, 1) ** 2.2
@dh = dh
@terrain_rough = lerp(lerp(0.92 - 0.15 * @wet * rk, 0.05, @Water), 0.85, @rd * land)
@sea_rough = 0.05 + 0 * x
# how much of each detail map applies (grass, rock, gravel: scree / sand / road, litter: forest floor)
dwr = @rd * land
@terrain_dw = set(gr * (1 - dwr), rk * (1 - dwr), (sc + sd) * (1 - dwr) + dwr, ff * (1 - dwr))

x = @u
y = @v
# grass: tufts and blades
g1 = pnoise(set(x * 24, y * 24, 1.1), 24)
g2 = pnoise(set(x * 64, y * 64, 2.2), 64)
g3 = pnoise(set(x * 160, y * 160, 3.3), 160)
tuft = smoothstep(0.42, 0.72, 0.6 * g1 + 0.3 * g2 + 0.2 * g3)
@det_grass = set(0.5, 0.52, 0.46) * (0.8 + 0.4 * tuft) * (0.92 + 0.16 * g3)
@h_grass = 0.05 * tuft + 0.01 * g3
# rock: grain, cracks (ridged noise), weathered patches
r1 = 1 - abs(2 * pnoise(set(x * 6, y * 6, 4.4), 6) - 1)
r2 = 1 - abs(2 * pnoise(set(x * 14, y * 14, 5.5), 14) - 1)
crack = max(smoothstep(0.9, 0.98, r1), 0.6 * smoothstep(0.92, 0.99, r2))
grain = pnoise(set(x * 120, y * 120, 6.6), 120)
patch = pnoise(set(x * 4, y * 4, 7.7), 4)
@det_rock = set(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) * (0.88 + 0.2 * grain + 0.08 * patch) * (1 - 0.35 * crack)
@h_rock = 0.03 * grain + 0.06 * patch - 0.04 * crack
# gravel: stones with dark gaps
s1 = pnoise(set(x * 40, y * 40, 8.8), 40)
s2 = pnoise(set(x * 90, y * 90, 9.9), 90)
stone = smoothstep(0.5, 0.62, s1 + 0.35 * (s2 - 0.5))
@det_gravel = set(0.5, 0.49, 0.47) * (0.65 + 0.55 * stone + 0.15 * s2)
@h_gravel = 0.035 * stone + 0.005 * s2
# leaf litter: patches of warm brown leaves and dark soil
l1 = pnoise(set(x * 20, y * 20, 11.1), 20)
l2 = pnoise(set(x * 70, y * 70, 12.2), 70)
leaf = smoothstep(0.45, 0.6, l1 + 0.4 * (l2 - 0.5))
@det_litter = lerp(set(0.42, 0.42, 0.40), set(0.58, 0.5, 0.4), leaf) * (0.85 + 0.3 * l2)
@h_litter = 0.02 * leaf + 0.01 * l2
